title: Hackathon
description: One competitive, time-boxed event with a submission deadline and a prize or certificate. Hackathons, ideathons, case competitions, CTFs, datathons and company challenges all qualify. Every row must anchor to a month by at least one of: run dates (starts/ends), or a registration deadline.

id.description: Stable slug. Normalised name + start month, e.g. hackx-2026-08. Must not change once published — the URL and any shortlist depend on it.

scope.description: city means the event is tied to one city; the city field is then required.

city.description: Required when scope is city. Omitted otherwise.

location.description: Free-text venue location as the source states it, for display. Carries places the city filter does not cover -- the filter's city list is India-first, and an in-person event in Los Angeles still has to say where it is.

starts.description: First day the event runs. null when the source only publishes a registration window -- never back-filled from a registration date.

ends.description: Last day the event runs. null for the same reason as starts.

registration_closes.description: null when the source does not state one. Never guessed — a wrong deadline is the most damaging error this dataset can make.

prize.description: Total prize pool as the source states it, in the source's own currency. null when there is no cash prize or none is stated; amount 0 means explicitly no cash prize. Never converted -- a converted figure would imply a precision and a date the source never gave.

team.description: min 1 means solo is allowed. max null means no stated upper limit.

source.description: Which seed this row came from. Kept so a systematically bad source can be found and dropped.

source_url.description: Where this row was found. Required so any claim can be checked.

also_seen_at.description: Other listings for the same event, kept when two sources are deduped so neither URL is lost.

last_seen.description: Last daily run that still found this event at its source. A stale last_seen is how a dead listing is spotted.

locked.description: Corrected by hand. The merge step must not overwrite a locked row.

synthetic.description: Generated for the stress test. Must never be true in data/hackathons.json.
